question: Can Skippy avoid full-vocabulary grammar filtering on valid proposals while matching llama.cpp performance and tool-call correctness?
proposal: Use upstream's sampling-first, single-token grammar validation and grammar-first fallback in Skippy's native chat sampler. Preserve lazy triggers, reasoning-budget handling, accepted-token history and MTP rejection recovery. Initialize the reused candidate array in a helper with by-value loop inputs, avoiding the reference-capturing lambda that prevented M6 vectorization. Do not disable grammar or change Max tool policy. Move evaluator grammar-validity assertions outside the timed interval. Before another production change, compare the unchanged revision-4 native sampler with llama.cpp in both baseline and candidate binaries using a diagnostic-only balanced control. Add conservative literal substring matching in llama_grammar_trigger_pattern::find for nonempty printable ASCII patterns without regex metacharacters/backslashes and with default ECMAScript flags. Retain regex construction and all regex fallback behavior. Preserve WORD-trigger activation across multiple token pieces; do not convert WORD triggers to TOKEN triggers.

execution.reason_for_pinning: All arms and paired blocks must use the same available Apple Silicon host; do not interrupt other campaigns.
execution.pr_gate: No PR before audited JY qualification passes. Private experiment branch commits/pushes are permitted to deliver immutable source to JY.

A.name: Existing Skippy
A.policy: Production Skippy full-vocabulary grammar-first chat sampling

B.name: llama.cpp reference
B.policy: Real common_sampler_sample with its default grammar_first=false

controls.primary_speculation: disabled in all arms to isolate the sampler; MTP correctness is a separate mandatory gate
controls.prefix_and_disk_cache: disabled for primary matched decode comparisons in every arm; do not alter the installed Max cache
controls.eos_policy: Honor EOS and identical stop rules in every arm
controls.instrumentation: Native monotonic timers; no Instruments during qualification
controls.source_control: Same compiler, optimization flags and patched llama baseline. Benchmark the real A/B/C entrypoints; no copied or simulated reference sampler. Record unavoidable adapter differences.
controls.adapter: Both native arms use the same llama_context configuration and directly exercise the production sampler entrypoints. Prompt history is settled before timing; generated history is settled inside the next timed sample. Matched decode is teacher-forced to remove output-length and logit-input confounds. This is not a Max end-to-end benchmark. Evaluator grammar-validity checks run after elapsed-time capture; failed checks still invalidate the job.
controls.resident_processes: One baseline process serves A/B and one candidate process serves C. Both remain resident; only one computes at a time. This avoids model loading between paired blocks.
controls.native_sampler_perf_counters: Disabled in all arms. Skippy uses llama_sampler_chain_default_params.no_perf=true; the reference explicitly sets common_params_sampling.no_perf=true. Only the evaluator monotonic timers measure sampling.

workloads.origin: Synthetic tool-calling fixtures, including the todo-app HTML pattern from the diagnostic run; no private user documents or credentials
workloads.identity_gate: Freeze fixture bytes, generated grammar, tokenizer identity, ordered token sequences/logit inputs and SHA-256 receipts before qualification. Record model-generated source traces separately from fixed replay inputs.
scopes: separate free-running tool-call correctness and MTP recovery
workloads.Unicode_boundary: The Unicode case includes a rare valid private-use code point. Admission verifies that at least one token piece begins with a UTF-8 continuation byte; a case name alone is not evidence of a split code point.

statistics.order: Balanced Latin-square A/B/C order, fixed before execution; all three arms sequentially in each block
statistics.confidence: One-sided 95% paired block-bootstrap confidence bounds, 10000 resamples, fixed bootstrap seed 7301
statistics.primary_aggregation: Paired geometric-mean ratios; retain per-case results and all block observations
statistics.exclusions: No outcome-based sample removal. Wrong inputs, identity mismatch, failed correctness, missing arm/block, concurrent JY job on the chosen node or observed thermal throttling invalidates the affected qualification job; retain it and run a new complete job. Missing required observations fail closed.
statistics.warmup_definition: Three discarded complete blocks before each measurement phase, with the same per-cell repetition counts.
statistics.development_overlap: All five synthetic cases are shared between screening and qualification. The 30 qualification timing blocks are fresh; do not describe repeats as independent dataset samples.
statistics.development_reference: Revision 2's planned five-block screen was stopped incomplete before outcome inspection. Revision 3 completed 30 fresh blocks and failed the sampler gate despite improving existing Skippy. Revision 4 requires its own verified build/correctness and five-block screen before 30 new qualification blocks. No earlier timing is reused. Revision 4 passed correctness but failed its five-block screen: aggregate sampler C/B 1.008926, upper 1.011759; lazy case 1.018528, upper 1.023724. Revision 5 first diagnoses unchanged native revision-4 code under the corrected timing boundary; no historical timing can qualify it.
statistics.screen_advancement: The five-block audit must pass within_one_percent and improves_existing. qualified_speed remains false until a separate 30-block qualification passes. Every original correctness, source, hardware, confidence and 1% gate remains mandatory.
statistics.screen_prerequisite: First verify the revision-5 diagnostic and apply diagnostic-decisions.json. If an independent-process follow-up is triggered, do not advance this candidate screen until that control is verified and any resulting process policy is frozen in a new protocol. Frozen baseline B remains primary; no normalization or comparator substitution.

qualification.correctness: All grammar/lazy-trigger/Unicode/fallback/EOS tests and MTP acceptance, rejection and checkpoint cleanup must pass. B/C seeded decision/state comparisons must pass under the admitted matching sampler configuration; any intentional semantic difference requires a new protocol revision before measurement. The candidate also runs 16 focused native tests: the previous 13 plus grammar parser, grammar integration and a differential literal-trigger test covering partial spellings, UTF-8 input pieces, embedded NUL input, regex escapes, captures, anchors and nondefault flags.
qualification.sampler_against_llama: Upper one-sided 95% confidence bound of C/B sampler latency ratio <= 1.01, including per-case results
qualification.decode_against_llama: Lower one-sided 95% confidence bound of C/B decode-throughput ratio >= 0.99
qualification.win_against_existing: C must improve on A with a paired confidence bound demonstrating the direction of the improvement; report native sampling and decode separately
qualification.recording: JY identity, artifacts and raw observations independently audited, accepted results uploaded to shared MLflow, and metrics/configuration/decisive artifacts read back before a PR may be opened

limitations: The prior local Instruments run is diagnostic only and cannot satisfy any qualification gate
A and B differ in grammar sampling order; arbitrary seeded A/C sequences need not match, but grammar validity and target semantics must be explicit
A result within 1% on a single uncontrolled timing is insufficient
Latest upstream beyond the frozen baseline is outside the initial comparison
The user selected Qwen3.5-9B Q4 for the 24 GB JY M6. This does not qualify 35B decode throughput.
The original M1 Ultra job was only a completed model/toolchain probe; it contributes no performance evidence.

Revision 2 was incomplete diagnostic screening against the installed 2c82637 source. Revisions 3 and 4 use the frozen 3947de0 baseline. Do not mix source revisions or reuse earlier qualification speed.
Revision 2 used the reference sampler default perf counters. Revisions 3 and 4 disable counters in all arms; no revision-2 performance is qualification evidence.

Revision 3 reduced aggregate sampler latency by 83.7% versus existing Skippy but remained 14.5% slower than llama.cpp. Its verified failed-gate result is retained in MLflow run f316392f8bf240bdbb906dbb5719a7b3. Instruments localized the residual to Skippy candidate initialization, whose scalar loop reloaded the captured vocabulary size per token while the reference used vector instructions.

The literal-trigger change is a new upstream grammar-matching capability in core patch 0012: no existing patch owns llama_grammar_trigger_pattern::find. It changes no public ABI. Non-ASCII or escaped pattern strings remain on regex. No environment-guard reorder is included.

prior_diagnostic.question: Distinguish native sampler overhead from process/build history under a corrected symmetric timing boundary. Inspect the growing-buffer lazy-trigger hypothesis before changing production matching.

prior_diagnostic.qualification: Diagnostic only. All six measured blocks and per-token observations retained. Report C/B, R/B and C/R paired ratios with confidence intervals; no PR or qualification claim follows from this diagnostic.
hypotheses: B normalizes the preserved single-token WORD tool trigger to a token ID while Skippy retains a regex. Growing-buffer regex matching may explain the increasing lazy-case excess.
A/B shared process history can affect B. This diagnostic compares reference implementations across binaries without running A.
The former C/A-only timed assertion could allocate a temporary error string. Moving it outside timing removes that evaluator asymmetry; magnitude is not presumed.
prior_diagnostic.next_candidate: If supported, conservative literal substring matching for provably literal nonempty ASCII trigger patterns, preserving multi-piece text semantics. Keep any environment-guard reorder as a separate production change.
prior_diagnostic.status: Pending verified execution; no performance evidence reused.
